create_votenet_model: create a VoteNet model for 3D object detection with specified class and proposal counts
run_forward_pass: run the VoteNet forward pass on a point cloud tensor and return detection end_points
compute_detection_loss: compute the loss for VoteNet predictions using ground truth labels and dataset config
dump_detection_results: dump VoteNet detection results to disk with predicted masks and dataset config
build_point_cloud_pipeline: build a 3D object detection pipeline with backbone feature learning, hough voting, and proposal generation
